fields.quoted_span: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or
fields.note: DX04 supports the core ban, the added 'or otherwise utilize' wording, and the bar on service providers facilitating agreements not to compete. It does not contain the definitions of Service Provider, coordination or nonpublic competitor information. It also does not contain the enforcement and private-right-of-action details; those come from the base ordinance.
DX04 lists 'Violations and penalties' as 'No Changes' and does not state the first-violation penalty, the $100 to $2,000 fine range, daily violations, attorney fees or the private right of action.
The field is empty, and DX04 states no effective date. It gives only adoption and approval dates.

fields.quoted_span: Adopted on second and final reading after hearing on Jul 16 2025
fields.note: DX04 shows the amendment was adopted and approved by the Mayor on Jul 17 2025. It does not say expressly that the rule is in force, so in_force is an inference.
